title: Management Team
description: The people building ai.market, a non-custodial B2B data marketplace, designed to be run primarily by AI agents with humans as strategic oversight.

sources.summary: About this review draft & factual sources
paragraphs: A proposed, humorous leadership page. The three model appointments and their human portraits are fictional. Model capabilities and customer results are attributed to their providers; they do not represent work completed at ai.market. Dry asides are editorial humor. Max’s profile is retained from the current page. Facts checked 6 November 2026.

Sol’s API price shown is for standard prompts up to 272K input tokens; long-context and other processing modes differ. Its default context in Codex and ChatGPT Work is 500K. Its cited model page does not disclose the detailed pre-training or post-training recipe.
